I'm researching how the Product Detail Page (PDP) and any accordion / product information UI is currently structured in this Salesforce PWA Kit (retail-react-app v10) codebase, to advise on how to split up a "PDP Product Information Accordion" user story.

Please explore and report back on:

1. **PDP page structure**: Find the product detail page under `overrides/app/pages/` (likely `product-detail/` or similar). Report what exists in `overrides/` vs. what is still only in the base template at `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/`. Summarize how the PDP is composed — what components it renders.

2. **Accordion usage**: Search both `overrides/` and `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/` for any existing Accordion component usage (Chakra `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`, etc.), especially anything related to product information / "Details & Care" / "Size & Fit" / "Shipping & Returns" tabs. In the base retail-react-app, the PDP has an `information-accordion` or similar — find it and report its path and structure.

3. **Existing product information / tabs components**: Look for anything named like `product-information`, `information-accordion`, `product-detail` accordions, tabs, or the section that renders "Details & Care", "Size & Fit", "Shipping & Returns", "Materials" etc.

4. **Contentful integration for PDP**: The repo has recent Contentful work. Check `overrides/app/` for how Contentful content is fetched/rendered (components, hooks, the `contentful` config). Is any product-adjacent content (like care instructions, sustainability/environmental info) sourced from Contentful vs. SFCC product attributes? Report what you find in `.docs/integration/` about Contentful too if a relevant doc exists.

5. **Component/override conventions**: Confirm the folder convention for a new component under `overrides/app/components/` (index.tsx, stories, etc.) by showing one representative existing custom component's folder layout.

Report file paths (repo-relative) and concise findings for each numbered item. Do NOT modify any files — this is read-only research. Quote small relevant code snippets where useful but keep it tight.

1	# 02 — Contentful (CMS)
2	
3	## 1. Purpose and scope
4	
5	Contentful is the headless CMS for editorial content: homepage modules, promotional banners, lookbooks, campaign landing pages, size guide fallback content (primary size guide is the Measmerize overlay — PRD-053), footer, and editorial blocks on PLPs and PDPs. The storefront reads published content via the **Delivery API (CDA)** from both SSR and the browser, reads draft content via the **Preview API (CPA)** in editor sessions, and receives **publish webhooks** to clear the SSR cache.
6	
7	In scope:
8	
9	- Reading published content via the Delivery API
10	- Reading draft content via the Preview API in editor preview sessions
11	- Live preview in Contentful Studio
12	- Locale-specific content via Contentful's native localisation
13	- Contentful Studio Experiences — drag-and-drop page composition by editors
14	- Receiving publish webhooks to clear stale SSR cache entries
15	
16	Out of scope of this document:
17	
18	- Content type schema sync (managed in code via the Management API — see §2)
19	- Asset uploads and content editing in Contentful Studio
20	- Webhooks from Contentful to SFCC (none planned)
21	
22	**Content ownership.** SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. On pages that mix both, editorial comes from Contentful and commerce data is resolved from SFCC. Product and category references in Contentful entries are authored via the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app and resolved at render (HPC-001). Rows marked *pending* are unconfirmed (see §11).
23	
24	| Surface | SFCC owns | Contentful owns | Status |
25	|---|---|---|---|
26	| Homepage | Commerce data for embedded product refs | All modules — hero, banners, campaign blocks | Confirmed |
27	| Campaign landing pages | Commerce data for embedded product refs | Full page (Contentful Studio Experiences) | Confirmed |
28	| Lookbooks | Commerce data for shop-the-look refs | Imagery, layout, copy | Confirmed |
29	| Size guides | — | Fallback content only — primary size guide is the Measmerize overlay (PRD-053, confirmed 2026-06-19); Contentful serves size guide content only where no Measmerize data exists for a given product | Updated |
30	| Footer | — | All content | Confirmed |
31	| PLP / category | Category results, product tiles, facets, pagination, hero/banner and editorial rows (SFCC BM — SPR-03/04/64) | Contentful-authored editorial rows, if any | *Whether any PLP editorial comes from Contentful is pending* |
32	| PDP | Product attributes, price, inventory, variations, gallery | Marketing copy, editorial blocks, size guide fallback (primary size guide is Measmerize — PRD-053) | *Which blocks are Contentful vs SFCC Page Designer is pending* |
33	| Navigation / mega-menu | Category tree | Promotional tiles, if any | *Pending* |
34	| Product badges | Badge labels and taxonomy — managed in SFCC BM product attributes (PRD-005); clickable badges link to category/PLP. Contentful is not the source of badge content unless explicitly confirmed. | — | Confirmed |
35	
36	## 2. Content type management (build-time)
37	
38	Content type schemas are managed in code, not in the Contentful UI:
39	
40	- Schema definitions live in the PWA repo and are reviewed via pull request.
41	- A sync script (Management API) idempotently upserts content types into the target environment. The sync script is authored to be additive only — it never deletes a field from a live content type.
42	- Each content type pairs with a typed React component. TypeScript types match the Contentful field IDs exactly, so schema drift is caught at compile time.
43	
44	## 3. Browser-side architecture
45	
46	```
47	PWA (SSR layer, then CSR hydration)
48	        │
49	        ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA) — published content
50	        │        SSR fetches server-side; browser also uses CDA on
51	        │        post-hydration reads. Public token, safe in bundle.
52	        │
53	        ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA) — draft content
54	        │        Editor preview only. Token set in MRT as an env var
55	        │        on dev/test/sit/uat only (never staging or prod).
56	        │        Reached client-side on the /preview route and via
57	        │        ?preview on Experience pages — both are gated: if no
58	        │        CPA token is present the routes fall back to a 404 /
59	        │        delivery mode. The Live Preview SDK requires the token
60	        │        in the browser for postMessage-based real-time updates.
61	        │
62	        ├──► Contentful Images API (images.ctfassets.net)
63	        │        srcset / sizes / avif|webp / quality parameters
64	        │
65	        └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful
66	                 Clears affected SSR cache keys on entry publish.
67	                 HMAC-verified with a shared secret.
68	```
69	
70	- **SSR first.** Editorial content for SEO- and LCP-critical pages (homepage, PLP, PDP, campaign landings) is fetched server-side. The browser hydrates from the SSR payload — no CDA call on first paint.
71	- **GraphQL for composed pages.** Where a page assembles many entries the storefront uses the GraphQL Content API to fetch only the needed fields in one request. REST CDA is used for simpler reads.
72	- **Live preview.** When an editor opens preview in Contentful Studio, the `/preview` route renders the entry inside Studio's iframe. The `@contentful/live-preview` SDK subscribes to `postMessage` events from Studio for real-time content updates. The CPA token is used client-side here — this is required by the SDK and is acceptable because: (a) the token is only set on dev/test/sit/uat only (never staging or prod) MRT environments, (b) the route returns a 404 when no preview token is present, and (c) the route is `noindex`. The MRT proxy approach was considered but deferred in favour of the simpler client-side SDK integration.
73	- **Asset delivery.** Images come from `images.ctfassets.net`. The storefront generates `srcset`, `sizes`, AVIF with WebP fallback, and quality parameters per breakpoint.
74	
75	## 4. Authentication and credentials
76	
77	| Token | Where used | Sensitivity |
78	|---|---|---|
79	| Delivery API token (CDA) | Browser bundle and SSR | Public — read-only, scoped to one environment. Safe to embed. |
80	| Preview API token (CPA) | `/preview` route and `?preview` on Experience pages (dev/test/sit/uat only — never staging or prod) | Semi-sensitive — exposes drafts. Set in MRT on dev/test/sit/uat only; never set on staging or prod. The `/preview` route returns 404 when token absent; Experience pages with `?preview` fall back to Delivery API mode. Used client-side by the Live Preview SDK (required for postMessage updates). |
81	| Management API token (CMA) | Build-time schema sync script | High. Held on the CI host only. Never embedded. |
82	| Webhook shared secret | MRT webhook receiver | High. Verifies HMAC on inbound publish webhooks. MRT environment variable. |
83	
84	Each environment has its own CDA, CPA, and webhook-secret values. The CMA token is per-Space and held only on the CI host.
85	
86	## 5. Data exchanged
87	
88	| Direction | Data | Mechanism |
89	|---|---|---|
90	| Storefront → Contentful | Content type ID, locale, filters, GraphQL query | CDA / Preview API HTTPS GET |
91	| Contentful → Storefront | JSON entries with resolved linked references | CDA / Preview API response |
92	| Contentful → Storefront (assets) | Image and video asset URLs | Images API |
93	| Contentful Studio ↔ PWA iframe | Live preview update events | Cross-origin `postMessage` |
94	| Contentful → MRT | Publish webhook with entry ID, content type, locale, environment | HTTPS POST with HMAC signature |
95	
96	No PII flows through Contentful.
97	
98	## 6. Performance and loading strategy
99	
100	- **SSR cache.** Contentful responses are cached at the SSR/edge layer — TTL 60 seconds with stale-while-revalidate. Publish webhooks clear the cache; the TTL is the fallback.
101	- **CDN rate limits.** Contentful allows 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token. The SSR cache absorbs almost all traffic so this limit is only a risk during burst republish events.
102	- **Images.** AVIF with WebP fallback via the Images API. Lazy loading on all below-the-fold images. The largest hero carries `fetchpriority="high"`.
103	- **Preconnect.** `images.ctfassets.net` is preconnected from the document head. `cdn.contentful.com` is not — first paint hydrates from SSR, so no browser CDA call is on the critical path.
104	- **Bundle weight.** The rich-text renderer is dynamically imported only on pages that use rich-text fields.
105	- **Field projection.** GraphQL queries select only the fields the component uses. REST queries use the `select` parameter where supported.
106	
107	## 7. Multi-region behaviour
108	
109	- A single Contentful Space serves all eight storefronts via Contentful's native locale model.
110	- The active locale is resolved from the URL prefix and passed as `locale=` on every CDA request. Eleven active locales: en-AU, en-US, en-GB, en (EU), fr, it, es, en-CH, en-HK, en-AE.
111	- Region-specific entries (banners, promotions, editorial that varies by site) are filtered at query time using the active SFCC site ID.
112	
113	## 8. Failure modes and graceful degradation
114	
115	| Failure | Behaviour |
116	|---|---|
117	| Contentful CDA unavailable | Page renders without editorial content. Editorial slots show empty; commerce data is never blocked on a CMS read. |
118	| Stale cached content after a publish | Tolerated within the 60-second TTL. The publish webhook normally clears affected entries in seconds; the TTL is the safety net if the webhook drops. |
119	| Preview API returns broken or unpublished refs | Editor preview only — render a placeholder. Production traffic never hits this path. |
120	| Asset (image) 404 | Show alt text and a graceful placeholder. |
121	| 429 rate limit on CDA | Exponential backoff and retry. The SSR cache makes this rare in practice. |
122	| Publish webhook fails HMAC verification | Reject and log. Storefront continues serving from cache; the TTL picks up the change. |
123	| Live preview iframe disconnects | Storefront silently returns to non-preview mode. |
124	
125	## 9. Security and privacy
126	
127	- The CDA token is read-only and scoped to one environment. Embedding in the bundle is safe per Contentful's published guidance.
128	- The CPA token is set in MRT on dev/test/sit/uat only — never on staging or prod. It reaches the browser on the `/preview` route (which returns 404 when no token is present) and `?preview` Experience pages (which fall back to Delivery API mode when no token is present). Both preview paths are `noindex` and not linked from any storefront navigation. This is a deliberate tradeoff: the Live Preview SDK requires the token client-side for real-time postMessage updates, and the non-prod-only gate means the token is never in a production bundle.
129	- The CMA token is held only on the CI host — never embedded, never in PR diffs.
130	- No PII is handled by Contentful.
131	
132	## 10. Open items requiring client confirmation
133	
134	1. **`regions` content-model field.** The working assumption is that region-specific entries are filtered by a `regions` field containing the relevant SFCC site IDs. Pending content-strategy and editor-workflow sign-off — this field affects how editors author content across all eight storefronts.
135	2. **SFCC vs Contentful content ownership on composed pages.** The principle is settled — SFCC owns all commerce data, Contentful owns editorial. Not yet confirmed is the split on composed pages: which editorial blocks appear on PDP and PLP, whether they are authored in SFCC Page Designer or Contentful, whether category landing pages are SFCC-routed or built in Contentful Studio Experiences, and whether the mega-menu includes Contentful-authored promotional tiles. The working assumption is in the ownership table in §1.
136	3. **Contentful Space and per-environment credentials.** Contentful to provide per-environment CDA token, CPA token, Space ID, environment ID, and webhook secret so the storefront can be tested against a real Contentful environment.
137

I have everything needed. Here is my research report. ## Summary This is retail-react-app **v10.0.0**. The PDP is **not overridden** in this repo — it runs entirely from the base template. The product-information accordion is a small, self-contained partial in the base package, and the repo already has a working Contentful integration pattern (hooks + typed components + config) that a new PDP accordion could plug into. --- ### 1. PDP page structure **No PDP override exists.** `overrides/app/pages/` contains only: `contentfulPreview/`, `experience/`, `home/`, `my-new-route/`. There is no `product-detail/`. The PDP is served entirely from the base template: - `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx` (~39 KB, the main page) - `.../product-detail/partials/information-accordion.jsx` (the only partial) - `.../product-detail/index.mock.js`, `index.test.js` Routing confirms this: `overrides/app/routes.tsx` spreads the base routes via `..._routes` and adds no `product-detail` entry, so the PDP route is inherited unchanged. **Composition** (from `index.jsx`): the page fetches product/category data, sets SEO via `Helmet`, then renders (all repo-relative to the base package): - `app/components/product-view` — `ProductView` (gallery, name, price, variation attributes, add-to-cart/wishlist). Wrapped in an `Island` with `hydrateOn="visible"`. - `app/pages/product-detail/partials/information-accordion` — `InformationAccordion`, rendered **right after** `ProductView` (line 808 for a normal product; line 776 for each child of a set/bundle). - `app/components/recommended-products` — `RecommendedProducts` (Einstein "Complete the Set" / "You might also like"), each in its own `Island`. So the accordion is a peer of `ProductView`, taking `product` as its only prop. --- ### 2. Accordion usage **Base product-information accordion:** `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/partials/information-accordion.jsx` (121 lines). It imports Chakra `Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionButton, AccordionPanel, AccordionIcon` from `app/components/shared/ui` and renders a hardcoded `` with **four fixed items**: 1. **"Product Detail"** — renders `product?.longDescription` via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` 2. **"Size & Fit"** — hardcoded "Coming Soon" 3. **"Reviews"** — "Coming Soon" 4. **"Questions"** — "Coming Soon" Each item is a `

...

` + ``. Items are not data-driven or conditionally rendered — they always render, even when empty. Message IDs follow `product_detail.accordion.button.*` / `product_detail.accordion.message.coming_soon`. **Accordion theming:** `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/theme/components/base/accordion.js` (base styles: `button.paddingLeft: 0`, no hover bg). The overrides theme (`overrides/app/theme/components/`) does **not** currently customize the accordion. **Other accordion in base (not PDP):** `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/nested-accordion/` + `app/theme/components/project/nested-accordion.js` — used for nested category/refinement menus, not product information. **Accordion usage in `overrides/`: none.** A grep for `Accordion` across `overrides/` returned zero matches. --- ### 3. Existing product information / tabs components The only such component is the base `information-accordion.jsx` above. There is **no** Tabs-based product-info component, no `product-information` component, and no "Details & Care" / "Shipping & Returns" / "Materials" component anywhere in `overrides/` or the base PDP. The strings "Details & Care", "Shipping & Returns", "Materials", "Care" do not exist in the base PDP — only "Product Detail", "Size & Fit", "Reviews", "Questions". **The PRD is where the target design lives** — `.docs/prd/pdp.md`: - Line 11 (PRD-008, confirmed): "Key supporting information in expandable accordions: **Details, Size & Fit, Care, Shipping & Free Returns** (region-specific content)". This is the real accordion the story targets — it differs from the base's Reviews/Questions items. - §12 (PRD-009, confirmed), lines 142-146: a separate **"Environmental Qualities / AGEC" accordion**, EU storefronts only (`/en-eu/`, `/fr-eu/`), **data sourced from AP21**, and **only renders when data exists** (no empty accordion). - §11 (lines 130-138): Size guide is a **Measmerize slide-out overlay**, with a **Contentful-managed content type as fallback** per product type — separate from the accordion. - Line 20 / 216: **product copy ownership (description/editorial) is still TBD** — Contentful vs SFCC vs AP21. These are natural seams for splitting the story: (a) refactor base accordion into a data-driven Zimmermann component with the correct item set, (b) Care/region-specific content wiring, (c) EU-only Environmental Qualities accordion (AP21 data, conditional render), (d) Size & Fit / size-guide overlay hookup. --- ### 4. Contentful integration for PDP The repo has a complete, custom Contentful pattern under `overrides/app/`: - **Config:** `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` — `getContentfulConfig()` pulls `app.contentful` from `getConfig()` (space/env/delivery+preview tokens, sourced from `config/default.js`). Plus `overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts` (+ `.generated.ts`) mapping SFCC site IDs → locales and MRT tiers → Contentful environments. Registered content types are minimal so far: `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS = { shoppableImage }`. - **Hooks:** `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts` — `useContentfulEntry(entryId, preview)` and `useContentfulEntries(contentType, preview)`. Client-side `fetch` against CDA/CPA with `include=2`, resolves linked assets, `AbortController` cleanup. - **Components:** `overrides/app/components/contentful/` — `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero`, plus `experiences/` (Studio Experiences: `shoppableImage`, `collectionHero`, `imageText`, `hotspotPopup/Marker`, `definitions.ts`). Barrel: `overrides/app/components/contentful/index.ts`. - **Types:** `overrides/app/types/contentful.ts`. **Product-adjacent Contentful content today:** the closest is `overrides/app/components/contentful/productHero.tsx`. Notably, it does **not** pull product copy from Contentful — it takes a Contentful-authored SFCC product **id** (`productHero` field) and resolves the actual data (`name`, `shortDescription`/`longDescription`, images) from **SFCC** via `useProduct` from `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`. It supports Contentful Live Preview via `ContentfulLivePreview.getProps`. This is the canonical example of the ownership rule: **Contentful references the product; SFCC owns the attributes.** **Doc:** `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` is the relevant doc. Key points for a PDP accordion: - Ownership table (§1): for **PDP**, SFCC owns product attributes/price/inventory/variations/gallery; Contentful owns marketing copy, editorial blocks, size-guide fallback. Crucially the PDP row and Open Item #2 (§10) both say **which blocks are Contentful vs SFCC Page Designer is still *pending***. - So **care instructions / sustainability (Environmental Qualities) are NOT confirmed as Contentful** — the PRD says Environmental Qualities comes from **AP21**, and product-copy ownership is explicitly TBD. Do not assume Contentful sourcing for accordion body content without confirmation. - SSR-first for PDP editorial; graceful degradation (empty editorial slots never block commerce data). --- ### 5. Component / override conventions A new component belongs under `overrides/app/components//`. Representative existing custom component — `overrides/app/components/button/`: - `index.tsx` — named export `export const Button` (+ props type `ButtonProps` declared at top), TypeScript, wraps Chakra primitives, styling delegated to the theme (`overrides/app/theme/components/button.ts`). - `index.stories.tsx` — Storybook 8.6 CSF3, `title: 'Elements/Button'`, `Default` + state exports. Folder-naming rule (from `.claude/skills/new-component/SKILL.md`): **`componentName/` (camelCase) for Zimmermann-authored** components, **`component-name/` (kebab-case) when overriding a base SF component**. Since the base is `product-detail/partials/information-accordion.jsx`, an override-style component would be kebab-case; a fresh Zimmermann component would be camelCase. Other conventions from the skill and rules it references (`.claude/rules/conventions.md`, `components.md`, `css.md`): - Import base package via the `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` alias — **never** from `node_modules/...` source directly. - Presentational components take data as **props**; parents/pages own data fetching (no commerce/React-Query hooks inside a leaf component). `productHero.tsx` is a mild exception because it's a container. - Chakra tokens only — no hardcoded hex/px/font sizes. - Story categories: `Foundation/ Elements/ Layout/ Commerce/ Forms/ Pages/ Contentful/`. A product-info accordion would likely be `Commerce/`. - Story mandatory; Vitest only for non-trivial logic; run `npx tsc --noEmit` after. Existing folder layouts range from a single `index.tsx` (`header/`, `pageContainer/`) to `index.tsx` + `index.stories.tsx` (`button/`) to multi-file (`icons/`: `index.tsx`, `icons.stories.tsx`, `zimm.tsx`; `contentful/` with a barrel `index.ts` + `experiences/` subfolder). --- ### Key file paths (repo-relative) - `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx` — base PDP (renders `InformationAccordion` at lines 776 & 808) - `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/partials/information-accordion.jsx` — the base accordion to refactor - `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/theme/components/base/accordion.js` — accordion base theme - `overrides/app/routes.tsx` — confirms PDP route inherited (no override) - `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts` — Contentful fetch hooks - `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts`, `overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts` — Contentful config/mapping - `overrides/app/components/contentful/productHero.tsx` — product-ref-from-Contentful, data-from-SFCC pattern - `overrides/app/components/button/` — representative custom component (folder convention) - `.claude/skills/new-component/SKILL.md` — scaffolding conventions - `.docs/prd/pdp.md` — target accordion spec (§lines 11, 130-146: Details/Size&Fit/Care/Shipping; Size Guide; EU Environmental Qualities) - `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` — Contentful ownership/architecture (PDP block ownership still *pending*, §1 + §10) One caveat worth flagging for the story split: the base accordion's items (Reviews, Questions) do **not** match the PRD's items (Care, Shipping & Free Returns), and the data sources for the PRD accordions are mixed/unconfirmed (SFCC `longDescription` today, AP21 for Environmental Qualities, Contentful for size-guide fallback, product-copy ownership TBD). That mismatch and the source ambiguity are the main seams to slice the story along.
